died.name: Anthony Babington
died.desc: English gentleman, conspirator in the Babington Plot
died.cause: prior to being hanged, drawn and quartered for high treason
died.last_words: The murder of the Queen had been represented to me as a deed lawful and meritorious. I die a firm Catholic.

died.name: Robert Emmet
died.desc: Irish Republican and Irish nationalist patriot, orator and rebel leader
died.cause: during execution by hanging for treason. The executioner carried out the hanging in the middle of Emmet's attempt to say "Not yet" for the third time

died.name: Richard Rowland Kirkland
died.cause: mortally wounded at the Battle of Chickamauga
died.last_words: Tell my father I died right.

died.name: Ryu Gwansun
died.cause: writing in prison before being tortured and beaten to death by Japanese prison officers
died.last_words: Even if my fingernails are torn out, my nose and ears are ripped apart, and my legs and arms are crushed, this physical pain does not compare to the pain of losing my nation. My only remorse is not being able to do more than dedicating my life to my country.

died.name: Tom Gastall
died.cause: final radio transmission before crash of his ERCO Ercoupe into Chesapeake Bay

died.name: Jim Croce
died.cause: in a letter written to his wife Ingrid shortly before he boarded a plane that killed him
died.last_words: Remember, it's the first 60 years that count and I've got 30 to go. I love you.

born.name: Thomas Wyatt the Younger
born.desc: English politician and leader of Wyatt's rebellion
born.cause: exculpating Princess Elizabeth and Edward Courtenay, 1st Earl of Devon, prior to execution by beheading for treason
born.last_words: What I then said I unsay now; and what I now say is the truth.

born.name: John F. Reynolds
born.desc: Union general of the American Civil War
born.cause: prior to being fatally shot at the Battle of Gettysburg
born.last_words: Forward men forward for God's sake and drive those fellows out of those woods.

born.name: Henry Arthur Jones
born.cause: when his nurse and his niece asked which of them he would prefer to stay with him
born.last_words: The prettier. Now fight for it.
